chunks: When We sent two of them they called them liars; so We sent a third to strengthen them. 'We have been sent to you,' they said.
ai.seo_question: Who were the three messengers sent to strengthen each other in Surah Yaseen?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the progressive strengthening of divine authority, where the initial rejection of two messengers necessitated the arrival of a third to establish undeniable proof (hujjah) for the people. This narrative structure underscores the theme of divine patience and the escalation of signs in response to human stubbornness, a pattern often linked to the eventual triumph of the Ahl al-Bayt. The 'third' messenger is sometimes interpreted symbolically to represent the completeness of the prophetic message or specific Imams who solidified the community's faith.
